title: A model case source key binds only the runners its pack uses
goal: Adding or changing a NERV system (no-model) runner in evals/gauntlet/runners.json no longer marks recorded model-pack cases as changed
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 on F-120-T15: "b" (fix the key first)
releaseSourceKey (tools/gauntlet.mjs) hashes the pinned release manifest and only the registry entries the pack's cases name, not the whole registry file
test/gauntlet.test.mjs F-120-T16 (committed failing first): a new or changed system runner leaves the cad-3d, coding and embedded keys unchanged; a change to the runner the pack runs changes its key
The key changes once with this step, so the 12 recorded cases stay source-changed until F-120-T17 reruns them; check:gauntlet-ledger is unaffected (it compares entries by pack, case and profile)
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: A real-model run needs the owner (F-120-T17 is approved by the F-120-T15 decision, at night only)

effort.basis: Owner decision b on F-120-T15, 2026-11-26: one function and one test. Not a measurement.
